message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).

| Location | Standard Time | Daylight‑Saving Time |
|----------|---------------|----------------------|
| Los Angeles | UTC‑8 | UTC‑7 |
| Berlin | UTC +1 | UTC +2 |

Because both regions shift forward by one hour at the same time of year, the 9‑hour gap remains constant throughout the year. So when it’s 12:00 pm noon in Los Angeles, it’s 9:00 pm the same day in Berlin.

Los Angeles is in Pacific Time (PT), which is UTC-8 standard, UTC-7 daylight saving. Berlin is Central European Time (CET) UTC+1 standard, UTC+2 daylight saving. So difference is 9 hours during standard time (Los Angeles behind Berlin by 9 hours). During daylight saving, Los Angeles is UTC-7, Berlin UTC+2, difference 9 hours again? Wait: Let's calculate: Standard: LA UTC-8, Berlin UTC+1 => difference 9 hours. Daylight: LA UTC-7, Berlin UTC+2 => difference 9 hours. So always 9 hours difference. But we might mention that Berlin is ahead of Los Angeles by 9 hours. Provide explanation. No function call needed.
